Inclusion Criteria: should report the absence of:
  -  anemia,
  -  diabetes,
  -  cardiovascular disease,
  -  and upper limb  [OR] and spinal muscular injuries in the last six months
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  absence at any study session and
  -  episode of muscle-tendon  [OR] or osteoarticular injury in the upper limbs during the study
